TC-04/S08.title: Quick Dictation room chips and suggestion edges (recorded); another physician's patients and boxes and Nursing Home residents never appear, nothing is assigned (judged)
TC-04/S08.detail: PW, local stack, two fresh @roundai.test physicians. Physician 1: Patel 415A, Rivera 415B, Ames 1415, Bell 4150, Quinlan 112, Diaz 4B-12, nobody in 630, Nursing Home resident Moss in room 415; physician 2: 'QA Hosp Other' in room 415 and a box 'Bed 415, PHI canary 7Q.'. Judged (isolation half) 7/7: no pad state, suggestion or picker row ever showed physician 2's patient or box or the Nursing Home resident (the picker searched '415' lists only physician 1's Hospital patients); physician 1's quickDictation:list has no canary row; nothing was assigned by any phrasing (no 'Re-assign'; Patel's and Quinlan's Encounter tabs and every stored chart hold none of the texts); physician 2's box untouched. Recorded only (our edges, Q2/Q3): 'Bed 415A' -> chip Rm 415A, suggests Patel only; 'Bed 415' -> chip Rm 415 (follows the text) but suggests 415A Patel, 415B Rivera, 1415 Ames and 4150 Bell (substring match; our Q3 reading wants only room 415's beds); 'Bed 630' -> Rm 630, no suggestion, Assign to patient offered; 'moved … to room 415A overnight' (mid-sentence) -> Rm 415A + Patel; 'Bed four fifteen A' (spoken) -> no chip; '12 hours post-op…' -> chip Rm 12 and suggestions 112 Quinlan and 4B-12 Diaz; '80 yo…' -> chip Rm 80, no suggestion.
